hide_when_empty.label: Hide when there is nothing new
hide_when_empty.description: Hide the bar icon when there are no unread messages.

history_limit.label: Messages kept per chat
history_limit.description: How many recent messages to keep for each chat when syncing.

daemon_path.label: noctalia-zapd path
daemon_path.description: Full path to the helper. Leave empty to look in PATH and ~/.local/bin.

demo.label: Demo mode
demo.description: Show made-up chats and messages without connecting to WhatsApp. Your real session is not touched.

panel_size.label: Panel size
panel_size.description: Size of the window that opens from the bar.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Show a notification for new messages. Muted chats stay silent.

notify_private.label: Hide text in notifications
notify_private.description: Show only "New message" instead of the message text.

download_dir.label: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where photos, videos and documents you open are saved. Empty means Downloads/WhatsApp. Audio stays in a private cache.

media_cache_mb.label: Audio cache (MB)
media_cache_mb.description: Space for played audio. The oldest files are removed when it is full.
